title: Professional Checklist & Resources
summary: A comprehensive pre-shipping checklist and resources for continued learning.

sections.content: Run through this checklist before deploying any FastAPI app to production.

items: All secrets in env / secret manager — zero hardcoded values
SECRET_KEY moved to env var, rotated periodically
Auth: short-lived JWTs (15-60 min), bcrypt passwords, rate-limited login
CORS locked to real origins; allow_credentials consistent
Input validation: extra='forbid', file type/size checks, no raw SQL
Security headers: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options via middleware
HTTPS everywhere (TLS at reverse proxy/load balancer)
Alembic migrations in CI; reviewed, never auto-applied blindly
Dependency overrides for DB and auth
Structured logs (JSON), request IDs, correlation IDs
Error shape consistent; 500s logged with tracebacks; nothing leaked to client
requirements.txt pinned; CI running lint (ruff) + tests

sections.content:
uvicorn main:app --reload                      # dev
uvicorn main:app --workers 4                   # prod
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "msg"       # new migration
alembic upgrade head                           # apply migrations
pytest -v                                      # run tests
docker compose up --build                      # full stack

sections.title: Build small, then adopt one advanced section at a time
sections.content: The recommended learning path: auth → database → testing → deployment. Don't try to adopt everything at once. Ship a small app, then add complexity incrementally.

code_challenge.title: Health Check Endpoint
code_challenge.description: Create a production-ready /health endpoint that returns app status, version, and a timestamp. This is used by Docker/Kubernetes healthchecks.
code_challenge.starter_code:

from fastapi import FastAPI

hints: This endpoint is used by Docker/Kubernetes for healthchecks
It should be lightweight and fast (no DB queries)

quiz.question: What should DEBUG be in production?
quiz.explanation: DEBUG must be False in production. Debug mode exposes detailed error pages, stack traces, and can leak sensitive information.

quiz.question: Should you use Base.metadata.create_all in production?
quiz.explanation: create_all only creates missing tables — it can't ALTER existing ones. Use Alembic for schema changes in production. It handles ALTER TABLE, column removal, and rollbacks.

quiz.question: What should a /health endpoint return?
options: A simple status (200 OK with status JSON)
quiz.explanation: A health endpoint should be lightweight and fast: return {"status": "healthy"} with 200. Don't query the database or do heavy work — Docker/Kubernetes calls it frequently.

quiz.question: What should you do with secrets in production?
options: Store in env vars / secret manager, never in git
Put them in a config file
quiz.explanation: Secrets must never be hardcoded or committed. Use environment variables or a secret manager (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault). In Docker, inject via environment, not files.

quiz.question: What is the recommended learning path for adopting FastAPI features?
options: auth → database → testing → deployment (one at a time)
quiz.explanation: Build small, then adopt one advanced section at a time. Ship a minimal app, then add auth, then database, then testing, then deployment. Incremental adoption prevents overwhelm.
